description: Submits a formation order to FilingDesk. THIS HAS A REAL-WORLD EFFECT: it records the order, notifies a FilingDesk specialist, and may send an automatic order-confirmation email to the customer's email address. The specialist then reviews the order, confirms name availability and the price, and emails a payment link. Nothing is charged at submission. Call only after preview_order, once the user has explicitly confirmed that summary (userConfirmed: true). Returns the order reference (FD-…).

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. "WY" or "Wyoming". All 50 states + DC.

userConfirmed.description: Must be true. Set only after the user has seen the preview_order summary and explicitly agreed to submit.

name: submit_order
title: Submit the formation order
